import sys
from collections import defaultdict

n = int(sys.stdin.readline())
players = defaultdict(int)
first_reach = {}

max_score = 0
winner = None

for _ in range(n):
    name, score = sys.stdin.readline().strip().split()
    score = int(score)
    players[name] += score
    
    if players[name] >= max_score:
        if players[name] > max_score or name not in first_reach:
            first_reach[name] = _
            max_score = players[name]
            winner = name

print(winner)
